summary: Gravel verge with parked cars, backing onto trees and playing fields.
reasons: Cars already park along this verge
Backs onto trees and sports fields

best_section.where: east side of Coldridge Street, along the tree belt beside the oval

drivers.seclusion: Tree belt and playing fields on the east; nearest building is a non-residential pavilion; apartments 58 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide dirt shoulder beside the lane with a row of cars parked on it; room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet campus lane ending at the oval car park; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars line the verge, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Works Zone and bus zone signs nearby; check on site
Oval and pavilion use likely on match days
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the verge, shade mainly from the east and midday.
